headline: Is Fair Isaac (FICO) Reasonable As Cash Flow Supports Earnings Concerns?
summary: Fair Isaac stock has compounded a 136.2% total return over the past 5 years, yet its valuation signals are split, with an intrinsic value estimate from a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) suggesting the shares trade below that estimate, while market multiples and a low value score point in the opposite direction. A 136.2% 5 year return puts Fair Isaac firmly in the long term winner camp, which often makes fresh buyers more sensitive to what they are paying today. The recent integration of FICO...
